name: Neverwinter Nights 2
description: Neverwinter Nights 2 is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game and the second in the Neverwinter Nights series.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2006 Neverwinter Nights 2 with its Mask of the Betrayer and Storm of Zehir expansions and the Mysteries of Westgate adventure pack. It's an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Neverwinter Nights 2's configuration.

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to 4.0 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to 5.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to 7.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to Pro Logic surround sound.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphones
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights 2's mixer to headphones.
